nodes.title: An annotated heterogeneous ultrasound database
nodes.summary: Collect a large-scale public ultrasound database to improve AI-assisted ultrasound diagnosis performance.
nodes.summaryZh: 构建大规模异构超声公开数据库，提升 AI 辅助超声诊断性能。

nodes.title: EM-Net: Effective and morphology-aware network for skin lesion segmentation
nodes.scholarTitle: EM-Net: Effective and morphology-aware network for skin lesion segmentation
nodes.summary: Propose a high-precision model for skin lesion segmentation in dermoscopic images.
nodes.summaryZh: 提出用于皮肤镜图像病灶分割的高精度形态感知模型。

nodes.title: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
nodes.scholarTitle: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
nodes.summary: A training-free module amplifies subtle lesion cues in frozen medical vision-language models to improve detection.
nodes.summaryZh: 通过免训练的病灶表征增强，提高医学视觉语言模型对细微病灶的识别能力。

nodes.title: DARD: Zero-Shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-Guided Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement
nodes.scholarTitle: DARD: Zero-Shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-Guided Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement
nodes.summary: Degradation-aware Retinex priors guide zero-shot diffusion to enhance low-light images and improve downstream segmentation.
nodes.summaryZh: 利用退化感知 Retinex 先验引导零样本扩散，改善低照度图像增强及下游语义分割。

nodes.title: UltraGS: Real-Time Physically-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting for Ultrasound Novel View Synthesis
nodes.scholarTitle: UltraGS: Real-Time Physically-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting for Ultrasound Novel View Synthesis
nodes.summary: The first to apply 3DGS to generate new ultrasound perspectives.
nodes.summaryZh: 首次将 3DGS 应用于超声新视角生成。

nodes.title: Federated Learning-Based Virtual Dual-Energy CT Generation from Single-Energy CT for Gout Detection
nodes.scholarTitle: Federated Learning-Based Virtual Dual-Energy CT Generation from Single-Energy CT for Gout Detection
nodes.summary: Introduces a federated learning framework for low-cost virtual DECT image generation to support accurate gout diagnosis.
nodes.summaryZh: 提出联邦学习框架进行低成本虚拟双能 CT 生成，支持痛风精准诊断。

nodes.title: Conductor: Dynamically orchestrating pipeline parallelism with multi-granularity control
nodes.summary: Proposes a dynamic two-tier scheduling framework to mitigate straggler-induced bubbles and improve pipeline-parallel training throughput.
nodes.summaryZh: 提出动态双层调度框架，缓解由慢节点引发的流水线气泡并提升流水线并行训练吞吐量。

nodes.title: DeepPET: An Intelligent Brain PET Device with Low Radiation and High Imaging Quality
nodes.summary: Integrates physical models with deep learning for efficient high-quality low-dose PET reconstruction.
nodes.summaryZh: 融合物理模型与深度学习，实现高质量低剂量 PET 高效重建。
